name: elixir.menu
description: Tools and recommendations for Elixir applications.
about: elixir.menu is an independent editorial guide by Optimum Tech for choosing tools for Elixir applications. Start with an application type, explore a Phoenix and LiveView web stack, and choose libraries by feature. Recommendations describe their reasons and limits so that a reader can make a decision in the context of a particular application.

The guide is not a framework or an installer. The complete set of optional libraries has not been tested as one integrated distribution. Canonical recommendation data and authored content generate the website and its Markdown and JSON exports together. Linked library repositories and documentation own the details of those projects.
